arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ

translations.en.sahih: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
translations.en.pickthall: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
translations.en.yusufali: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
translations.id.indonesian: Hai orang yang berkemul (berselimut),

translations.en.sahih: Arise and warn
translations.en.pickthall: Arise and warn!
translations.en.yusufali: Arise and deliver thy warning!
translations.id.indonesian: bangunlah, lalu berilah peringatan!

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord glorify
translations.en.pickthall: Thy Lord magnify,
translations.en.yusufali: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
translations.id.indonesian: dan Tuhanmu agungkanlah!

translations.en.sahih: And your clothing purify
translations.en.pickthall: Thy raiment purify,
translations.en.yusufali: And thy garments keep free from stain!
translations.id.indonesian: dan pakaianmu bersihkanlah,

translations.en.sahih: And uncleanliness avoid
translations.en.pickthall: Pollution shun!
translations.en.yusufali: And all abomination shun!
translations.id.indonesian: dan perbuatan dosa tinggalkanlah,

translations.en.sahih: And do not confer favor to acquire more
translations.en.pickthall: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
translations.en.yusufali: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
translations.id.indonesian: dan janganlah kamu memberi (dengan maksud) memperoleh (balasan) yang lebih banyak.

translations.en.sahih: But for your Lord be patient.
translations.en.pickthall: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
translations.en.yusufali: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan untuk (memenuhi perintah) Tuhanmu, bersabarlah.

translations.en.sahih: And when the trumpet is blown,
translations.en.pickthall: For when the trumpet shall sound,
translations.en.yusufali: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila ditiup sangkakala,

translations.en.sahih: That Day will be a difficult day
translations.en.pickthall: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
translations.en.yusufali: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
translations.id.indonesian: maka waktu itu adalah waktu (datangnya) hari yang sulit,

translations.en.sahih: For the disbelievers - not easy.
translations.en.pickthall: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: Far from easy for those without Faith.
translations.id.indonesian: bagi orang-orang kafir lagi tidak mudah.

translations.en.sahih: Leave Me with the one I created alone
translations.en.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
translations.en.yusufali: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
translations.id.indonesian: Biarkanlah Aku bertindak terhadap orang yang Aku telah menciptakannya sendirian.

translations.en.sahih: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
translations.en.pickthall: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
translations.en.yusufali: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Aku jadikan baginya harta benda yang banyak,

translations.en.sahih: And children present [with him]
translations.en.pickthall: And sons abiding in his presence
translations.en.yusufali: And sons to be by his side!-
translations.id.indonesian: dan anak-anak yang selalu bersama dia,

translations.en.sahih: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
translations.en.pickthall: And made (life) smooth for him.
translations.en.yusufali: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
translations.id.indonesian: dan Ku-lapangkan baginya (rezeki dan kekuasaan) dengan selapang-lapangnya,

translations.en.sahih: Then he desires that I should add more.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
translations.en.yusufali: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian dia ingin sekali supaya Aku menambahnya.

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak (akan Aku tambah), karena sesungguhnya dia menentang ayat-ayat Kami (Al Quran).

translations.en.sahih: I will cover him with arduous torment.
translations.en.pickthall: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
translations.en.yusufali: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
translations.id.indonesian: Aku akan membebaninya mendaki pendakian yang memayahkan.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
translations.en.pickthall: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
translations.en.yusufali: For he thought and he plotted;-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia telah memikirkan dan menetapkan (apa yang ditetapkannya),

translations.en.sahih: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
translations.en.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
translations.en.yusufali: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
translations.id.indonesian: maka celakalah dia! Bagaimana dia menetapkan?,

translations.en.sahih: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
translations.en.pickthall: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian celakalah dia! Bagaimanakah dia menetapkan?,

translations.en.sahih: Then he considered [again];
translations.en.pickthall: Then looked he,
translations.en.yusufali: Then he looked round;
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian dia memikirkan,

translations.en.sahih: Then he frowned and scowled;
translations.en.pickthall: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
translations.en.yusufali: Then he frowned and he scowled;
translations.id.indonesian: sesudah itu dia bermasam muka dan merengut,

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned back and was arrogant
translations.en.pickthall: Then turned he away in pride
translations.en.yusufali: Then he turned back and was haughty;
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian dia berpaling (dari kebenaran) dan menyombongkan diri,

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
transliteration: Faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar

translations.en.sahih: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
translations.en.pickthall: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
translations.en.yusufali: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
translations.id.indonesian: lalu dia berkata: "(Al Quran) ini tidak lain hanyalah sihir yang dipelajari (dari orang-orang dahulu),

translations.en.sahih: This is not but the word of a human being."
translations.en.pickthall: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
translations.en.yusufali: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
translations.id.indonesian: ini tidak lain hanyalah perkataan manusia".

translations.en.sahih: I will drive him into Saqar.
translations.en.pickthall: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
translations.en.yusufali: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: Aku akan memasukkannya ke dalam (neraka) Saqar.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
translations.en.pickthall: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah (neraka) Saqar itu?

translations.en.sahih: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
translations.en.pickthall: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
translations.en.yusufali: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
translations.id.indonesian: Saqar itu tidak meninggalkan dan tidak membiarkan.

translations.en.sahih: Blackening the skins.
translations.en.pickthall: It shrivelleth the man.
translations.en.yusufali: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
translations.id.indonesian: (Neraka Saqar) adalah pembakar kulit manusia.

translations.en.sahih: Over it are nineteen [angels].
translations.en.pickthall: Above it are nineteen.
translations.en.yusufali: Over it are Nineteen.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan di atasnya ada sembilan belas (malaikat penjaga).

arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
transliteration: Wa maaja''alnaaa As haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar

translations.en.sahih: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
translations.en.pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiada Kami jadikan penjaga neraka itu melainkan dari malaikat: dan tidaklah Kami menjadikan bilangan mereka itu melainkan untuk jadi cobaan bagi orang-orang kafir, supaya orang-orang yang diberi Al-Kitab menjadi yakin dan supaya orang yang beriman bertambah imannya dan supaya orang-orang yang diberi Al Kitab dan orng-orang mukmin itu tidak ragu-ragu dan supaya orang-orang yang di dalam hatinya ada penyakit dan orang-orang kafir (mengatakan): "Apakah yang dikehendaki Allah dengan bilangan ini sebagai suatu perumpamaan?" Demikianlah Allah membiarkan sesat orang-orang yang dikehendaki-Nya dan memberi petunjuk kepada siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya. Dan tidak ada yang mengetahui tentara Tuhanmu melainkan Dia sendiri. Dan Saqar itu tiada lain hanyalah peringatan bagi manusia.

translations.en.sahih: No! By the moon
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, by the Moon
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak, demi bulan,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it departs
translations.en.pickthall: And the night when it withdraweth
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Night as it retreateth,
translations.id.indonesian: dan malam ketika telah berlalu,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
translations.en.pickthall: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan subuh apabila mulai terang.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
translations.en.yusufali: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Saqar itu adalah salah satu bencana yang amat besar,

translations.en.sahih: As a warning to humanity -
translations.en.pickthall: As a warning unto men,
translations.en.yusufali: A warning to mankind,-
translations.id.indonesian: sebagai ancaman bagi manusia.

arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
transliteration: Liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar

translations.en.sahih: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
translations.en.yusufali: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) bagi siapa di antaramu yang berkehendak akan maju atau mundur.

translations.en.sahih: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
translations.en.pickthall: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
translations.en.yusufali: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
translations.id.indonesian: Tiap-tiap diri bertanggung jawab atas apa yang telah diperbuatnya,

translations.en.sahih: Except the companions of the right,
translations.en.pickthall: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
translations.en.yusufali: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali golongan kanan,

translations.en.sahih: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
translations.en.pickthall: In gardens they will ask one another
translations.en.yusufali: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
translations.id.indonesian: berada di dalam surga, mereka tanya menanya,

translations.en.sahih: About the criminals,
translations.en.pickthall: Concerning the guilty:
translations.en.yusufali: And (ask) of the Sinners:
translations.id.indonesian: tentang (keadaan) orang-orang yang berdosa,

translations.en.sahih: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
translations.en.pickthall: What hath brought you to this burning?
translations.en.yusufali: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
translations.id.indonesian: "Apakah yang memasukkan kamu ke dalam Saqar (neraka)?"

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
translations.en.pickthall: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami dahulu tidak termasuk orang-orang yang mengerjakan shalat,

translations.en.sahih: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor did we feed the wretched.
translations.en.yusufali: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
translations.id.indonesian: dan kami tidak (pula) memberi makan orang miskin,

translations.en.sahih: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
translations.en.pickthall: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
translations.en.yusufali: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
translations.id.indonesian: dan adalah kami membicarakan yang bathil, bersama dengan orang-orang yang membicarakannya,

transliteration: Wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid Deen

translations.en.sahih: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
translations.en.pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
translations.en.yusufali: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
translations.id.indonesian: dan adalah kami mendustakan hari pembalasan,

translations.en.sahih: Until there came to us the certainty."
translations.en.pickthall: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
translations.en.yusufali: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
translations.id.indonesian: hingga datang kepada kami kematian".

translations.en.sahih: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
translations.en.pickthall: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
translations.en.yusufali: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tidak berguna lagi bagi mereka syafa'at dari orang-orang yang memberikan syafa'at.

translations.en.sahih: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
translations.en.pickthall: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
translations.en.yusufali: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mengapa mereka (orang-orang kafir) berpaling dari peringatan (Allah)?,

translations.en.sahih: As if they were alarmed donkeys
translations.en.pickthall: As they were frightened asses
translations.en.yusufali: As if they were affrighted asses,
translations.id.indonesian: seakan-akan mereka itu keledai liar yang lari terkejut,

translations.en.sahih: Fleeing from a lion?
translations.en.pickthall: Fleeing from a lion?
translations.en.yusufali: Fleeing from a lion!
translations.id.indonesian: lari daripada singa.

arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
transliteration: Bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah

translations.en.sahih: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
translations.en.yusufali: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan tiap-tiap orang dari mereka berkehendak supaya diberikan kepadanya lembaran-lembaran yang terbuka.

translations.en.sahih: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
translations.en.yusufali: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak. Sebenarnya mereka tidak takut kepada negeri akhirat.

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak demikian halnya. Sesungguhnya Al Quran itu adalah peringatan.

translations.en.sahih: Then whoever wills will remember it.
translations.en.pickthall: So whosoever will may heed.
translations.en.yusufali: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka barangsiapa menghendaki, niscaya dia mengambil pelajaran daripadanya (Al Quran).

arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
transliteration: Wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; Huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah

translations.en.sahih: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
translations.en.pickthall: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka tidak akan mengambil pelajaran daripadanya kecuali (jika) Allah menghendakinya. Dia (Allah) adalah Tuhan Yang patut (kita) bertakwa kepada-Nya dan berhak memberi ampun.
